tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Shortcut user including name, role, and workspace info.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search for stories by text query. Uses Shortcut search operators (e.g., "is:started", "type:bug", "label:backend"). Returns paginated results.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific story by its numeric ID. Returns full story data including labels, story links, comment IDs, and task IDs.

tools.name: create_story
tools.description: Create a new story in Shortcut. Requires a name and story type. Optionally set description, workflow state, epic, iteration, owners, labels, estimate, and deadline.

tools.name: update_story
tools.description: Update an existing story. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: delete_story
tools.description: Permanently delete a story by its numeric ID. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_story_comments
tools.description: List all comments on a story, ordered by creation date.

tools.name: create_story_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a story. Supports Markdown formatting.

tools.name: create_story_link
tools.description: Create a relationship between two stories. Types: "blocks" (subject blocks object), "duplicates" (subject duplicates object), "relates to" (bidirectional).

tools.name: list_epics
tools.description: List all epics in the workspace. Returns epics with name, state, and associated labels.

tools.name: get_epic
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific epic by its numeric ID.

tools.name: create_epic
tools.description: Create a new epic. Requires a name. Optionally set description, state, deadline, owners, and labels.

tools.name: update_epic
tools.description: Update an existing epic. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: delete_epic
tools.description: Permanently delete an epic by its numeric ID. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_epic_stories
tools.description: List all stories that belong to a specific epic.

tools.name: search_epics
tools.description: Search for epics by text query. Returns matching epics with pagination.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List all labels in the workspace. Labels are used to categorize stories and epics.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a new label in the workspace.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List all workflows and their states. Each workflow contains ordered states (e.g., Unstarted, In Progress, Done). Use state IDs when creating or updating stories.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List all members in the workspace including their name, role, email, and mention handle.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List all teams (groups) in the workspace. Teams organize members and are associated with workflows.

tools.name: list_iterations
tools.description: List all iterations (sprints) in the workspace. Returns iteration name, date range, and status.

tools.name: get_iteration
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific iteration (sprint) by its numeric ID.

tools.name: create_iteration
tools.description: Create a new iteration (sprint). Requires name, start date, and end date.

tools.name: update_iteration
tools.description: Update an existing iteration. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: list_iteration_stories
tools.description: List all stories that belong to a specific iteration (sprint).

tools.name: list_objectives
tools.description: List all objectives in the workspace. Objectives are high-level goals that epics work toward.
